intro: A new sound for the Pipe Worm's spit (2026-10-19). It used to make two sounds, a goo inhale while it charged and the slime's own goo ptoo when it spat; now the charge is silent and the spit has one sound of its own. Three new short Magnific ideas, three takes each (the game picks one at random each spit); "Now" is the ptoo it played before. Press Repeat to hear an option several times in a row at the game's small pitch spread. Pick one, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.

groups.name: Pipe Worm spit
groups.note: The worm in its pipe spits a mud glob at the slime (every 1.7 s while the slime is in front of its wall). The charge before it is silent now, so this is its only sound.
